messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Production alert — streaming inference p99 latency for model:redwood-embed-7b:int8 in eu-west-1 has breached SLO (p99 = 1.9s, threshold = 1.2s) and we are seeing streaming stalls / chunk timeouts. Paging on-call.

 tim_oncall: I'm on it. grabbing recent dashboards and calibs. can someone confirm if the int8 precision-profile rollout started in eu-west-1 ~08:10 UTC?

 sre_maria: yes, we kicked an int8 calibration profile to canary nodes at 08:08 UTC for redwood-embed-7b (auto-calib pipeline). rollout config: `precision_profile: int8-calib-v3 -> canary 20%`.

 eng_raj: saw spikes on KV cache miss rate around the same time, ~08:12. streaming agents are stalling on dequant K/V fetch. stack traces show repeated `KVFetchTimeout` from runtime. snippet: 
```
2026-03-11T08:12:14Z runtime ERROR dequant_kv.cpp:142 KVFetchTimeout key=slot_... seq=1024 retries=3
2026-03-11T08:12:15Z runtime WARN stream.cpp:87 chunk_delay=120ms chunk_retry=2
```

 platform_lee: also noticed sudden increase in CPU wait on nodes running the canary. might be dequant path contention with int8 kernels.

 tim_oncall: priority: keep customers unaffected. immediate mitigation options: 1) pause / rollback int8-canary profile 2) route streaming traffic for that model to fp16 variant (fallback) 3) increase stream chunk timeout while we triage. Which is fastest?

 sre_maria: fastest = pause rollout. I can hit the rollout API now. command: 
```
# pause canary
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFER_TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.redwood.ai/api/v1/precision-rollouts/rollback \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-7b","target":"int8-calib-v3","percentage":0}'
```

 eng_raj: routing fallback probably takes ~2-3 mins to propagate to edge routers but gives best short-term SLO protection. we have fp16 variant `redwood-embed-7b:fp16-stable` available in eu-west-1. I can flip route.

 support_june: flagging CS + TOP customers with streaming-heavy usage. prepare to message if mitigation takes >10m.

 tim_oncall: do both: pause rollout (maria) + route to fp16 (raj). I'll increase stream chunk timeout to reduce apparent stalls while changes roll. executing now.

 sre_maria: rollback API returned 202 accepted. monitoring rollout controller: progress -> canary percentage -> 0.

 eng_raj: routing change pushed: traffic-rule updated to prefer `redwood-embed-7b:fp16-stable` for streaming routes in eu-west-1. propagation started (CDN+edge rules).

 tim_oncall: bumping runtime stream chunk timeout from 150ms -> 400ms on eu-west-1 service group to avoid client backpressure during switchover. cmd: `redwoodctl service update --region eu-west-1 --stream-timeout 400`

 incident-bot: Alert: rollback confirmed at 08:16:22 UTC; routing fallback in-progress; watch metrics for p95/p99 and chunk_retries.

 eng_raj: post-change metrics: p95 dropped from 600ms -> 340ms; p99 trending down from 1.9s -> 1.0s. stream chunk retry count falling.

 sre_maria: logs show dequant errors stop appearing on canary nodes after rollback. sample: `KVFetchTimeout` no longer present after 08:16:30.

 support_june: contacting two customers (Acct: AtlasAI, RetailCo) — both reported intermittent timeouts ~08:13-08:17. letting them know we're rolling back int8 canary and routing to fp16; will follow up once SLOs stable.

 tim_oncall: good. one remaining item: confirm if calibration telemetry triggered a bad quant table for long-context sequences (>2k tokens). eng_raj, can you grep for sequences with context>2048 around failure window?

 eng_raj: got it. grep output: 
```
grep "ctx_len>2048" /mnt/runtime/logs/eu-west-1/redwood-embed-7b/* | wc -l
=> 482 matches between 08:05-08:20
```
and many of those correlate with higher tokenization churn and longer KV chains. looks like the int8 calibration didn't account for long context scaling => dequant path underprovisioned.

 platform_lee: note for postmortem: calibration job used sample_set=A_small_sessions (biased to <512 tokens). need to expand sample set to include tail contexts before canarying.

 tim_oncall: next steps: - create incident ticket (I'll open) - keep canary rolled back and routing to fp16 for 2h - SRE/infra to run calibration-sim with long-context seeds - Product/CS to triage customer impact and messaging - schedule postmortem with eng_maria/raj/lee.

 incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0311-045 (latency-p99-int8-calib-eu). Severity: SEV2. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0311-045

 support_june: customers updated. AtlasAI wants a post-incident note and asks if their latency SLA credits apply. I'll open CLM runbook entry.

 sre_maria: I'll run calibration-sim now with extended contexts and share results in the runbook. command: 
```
python tools/calib_sim.py --model redwood-embed-7b --samples path=sample_sets/long_context_2k.json --out /tmp/calib_run_4609
```

 eng_raj: confirming telemetry: by 08:22 p99 is back under threshold (0.95s). continuing to watch for 30m.

 tim_oncall: handing off to sre_maria for monitoring / postmortem. I'll be on standby for escalation. Please update INC ticket with timeline and links to rollback + routing change.

 sre_maria: taking over watch. notes saved to incident: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0311-045/notes. will compile logs and preliminary root cause: int8 calibration sample bias -> dequant path contention on long-context workloads.

 eng_raj: putting a temporary guard in runtime to reject int8 calib if sample_set_missing_long_context=true. will PR fix and feature-flag for safe re-rollout.

 support_june: leaving a follow-up message to customers: short summary, mitigation, next steps, invite to postmortem.

 tim_oncall: thanks team. triage complete for now — leaving this thread open for any late regressions. :thumbsup:
